register_audit: roadman-only: mandem, allow, ends, fam, wallahi, bless up. No gen-z markers (no cap/fr/bussin/vibe/delulu/lowkey).
label: original invocation in roadman voice — NOT a translation, NOT canonical
title: Wake-up (prabodhana)
text:
MANDEM. WAKE THE FUCK UP — God's calling.
Allow the lie-in, put the phone down, get up.
Wallahi He's outside your ends saying your name right now.
You been asleep long enough, fam. Rise up. Bless up.
notes: morning-awakening genre (prabhāta-stotra): the call, the dismissal of sleep, divine proximity, the response. Four moves, four lines.
